title: Preserve parenthesized submodule paths in refusal diagnostics
outcome: Uninitialized or conflicted submodules whose paths end in parentheses are refused with their complete path, without mistaking path text for Git's revision annotation.
acceptance: A recursive submodule status row for an uninitialized child named 'child (vendor)' is refused with the entire name and the uninitialized reason.
Conflicted rows retain the entire parenthesized path, including a path beginning with a space, while initialized rows still remove only their Git revision annotation.
Parser regressions cover these diagnostic cases without adding file/index scans or changing successful admission behavior.

completion.summary: Preserve complete parenthesized submodule paths in uninitialized/conflicted refusal diagnostics; the reviewed and fully gated candidate is pushed to origin/master, installed, and ready across all six live stores.
